Four merged PRs since 2026-04-11 added or removed a line containing `getExtensionConfig` under `packages/framework`, all on the main line up to the head (`7a172083`):

1. **#1934** (commit `744dd2a`), merged 2026-10-05. "Framework and E2E test fixes." It removes `getExtensionConfigFromStore(...)` from `createExtensionConfigPromise` in `esm-react-utils/src/useConfig.ts` and adds it back in `whenConfigReady`. It also removes `getExtensionConfig(slotName, extensionId)` from the `getTranslationOverrides` test code in `module-config.test.ts`.
2. **#1922** (commit `c1bfbcb`), merged 2026-09-30. "Minimize churn from config updates when there are many extensions." It adds new `module-config.test.ts` tests that call `getExtensionConfig('barSlot', ...)`.
3. **#1870** (commit `2864290`), merged 2026-09-09. "Ensure slot-specific configuration are correctly passed everywhere." It adds `module-config.test.ts` tests that call `getExtensionConfig('barSlot', 'fooExt#id6')` and similar.
4. **#1856** (commit `9042cb6`), merged 2026-09-02. "Extension system should not re-derive in full on every write." It removes `getExtensionConfig` from the `getTranslationOverrides` code in `module-config.ts` and from the `module-config.test.ts` import and call sites.

Merge dates are the commit dates, which I'm taking as the merge times for these squash-merged PRs.

How I got there: I listed the commits touching the five files that contain the term at head, then pulled the diff for each candidate. Commits 8aa137c (#1827) and 040fd95 (#1?) touched the module-config directory but only changed lint directives and doc links, so they don't count. 744dd2a's `useConfig.ts` diff is the clearest example of a removed line. For #1894 (`a62f816`, rxjs removal), I checked `esm-extensions/src/extensions.ts`, `esm-react-utils` and the `esm-framework` mock files, and none had a matching line. Its full `esm-framework` diff was too large to read in one call and the saved copy was not readable, so that check is incomplete.

I did not diff all 86 framework commits. A commit that removed a matching line from a file I didn't check could be missing, most likely among other `esm-framework` changes.

Current-head locations of the term, for reference: `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/state.ts` lines 181 and 187, `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-extensions/src/extensions.ts` lines 449 and 450, `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useConfig.ts` lines 36, 112 and 130, `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/module-config.ts` line 562 and `module-config.test.ts` line 1745.
